verdict.rationale: Custom dashboards are a fair question for an LLM observability platform like Phoenix, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents building custom dashboards. It shows only adjacent features: latency inspection of slow invocations, token-usage breakdowns, eval scoring of traces, and SDK span querying. Those are views and building blocks, not a user-configurable dashboard over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
